summary: This prototype combines an STM32L4-based controller with precision Sensirion SHT40 temperature/humidity sensors to implement real-time environmental monitoring and HVAC actuation. The architecture supports Modbus RTU and Wi-Fi/BLE network bridges, providing dual standalone industrial automation control and secure telemetry ingestion into cloud dashboards.
